question: Which suffix is used when the -CHO group is attached to a carbon atom of a ring or ring system, or to a heteroatom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbaldehyde.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The suffix used when the **-CHO group **is attached to a** carbon atom** of a ring or ring system, or to a** heteroatom is "carbaldehyde".**</li&g
